title: Resolve an individual reflected parameter from outside Spring Test
summary: An external consumer on the landing resolved a qualified method parameter to west. Reusing one generic declaration with two containing classes selected the corresponding west and east singletons.

change.description: Two submitted commits landed as one. AutowireUtils in spring-beans now publicly exposes isAutowirable and resolveDependency. SpringExtension delegates to them. A separate test framework can use the same parameter metadata and factory.

notes: The Jupiter control exercised SpringExtension on both revisions. These exact AutowireUtils signatures were subsequently replaced before a published release.
Each pin supplies its changed production classes on spring-5.2.0.M1-q04. The replay verifies the loaded class origins and all class digests of each compiled slice.

The unchanged external source also failed javac on the original parent because AutowireUtils was package-private. Changing to the shipped ParameterResolutionDelegate on Spring 5.2.0.M1 reproduced all three landing histories.
